text:
In the first scene, I feel a quiet sense of curiosity and separation—an observer, present but outside the glass walls that contain a group deeply engaged in discussion or learning. The physical barrier amplifies a sense of philosophical distance, as if I can reflect on the energy of collaboration without being swept up in it.

In the second scene, I am closer, actively seeking understanding—looking at the exhibit, absorbing the ideas of research, development, and innovation. There is an intimacy here, a contemplative mood as I ponder creativity, progress, and how knowledge takes shape. I am reminded of the endless journey of learning and coexisting with new thoughts and people.
